works.body:
Hello! Welcome to Skeb! I love your dark and mysterious paintings!

Please draw my OC, Mockingbird. She's a harpy and ex-villain with a chaotic and yandere personality.

Feel free to draw her however you like.

Notes:
- 20 years old
- 173cm
- Chaotic and reckless, but can also be soft and sweet like a big sister
- Also possesses an unhinged villainous side when angered
- Has sharp claws and fangs
- The wings covering her arms are important
- Her wings are large and hide her muscles
- The shackles on her wrists are a very important detail and can't be removed

Even though she has a muscular figure, you may tone it down to fit your style if needed, or cover her arms with more feathers. Thank you for considering!
